notes: New: A Select tool, the arrow button at the left of the markup toolbar (or press V). Click anything you added to pick it, then move it or drag its corners to resize it.
New: Pen strokes, highlights, shapes and blurs can now be picked, moved and resized, not just text.
Improved: Double-click a piece of text with the Select tool to edit it.
Improved: Choosing a save folder now shows a clear message right under the buttons, so you always know what happened.
Fixed: When a folder can't be chosen on this page, the button now says so instead of seeming to do nothing.
